theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (r₀ s : ℝ) (γ : ℝ → Euclid P), 0 < s → s < r₀ → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 γ (Ioo (-s) s) → InjOn γ (Ioo (-s) s) → (∀ α ∈ Ioo (-s) s, ‖γ α‖ = 1 ∧ inner ℝ (γ α) (deriv γ α) = 0 ∧ deriv γ α ≠ 0) → InjOn (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => q.1 • γ q.2) (Ioo (r₀ - s) (r₀ + s) ×ˢ Ioo (-s) s) ∧ ∀ z ∈ Ioo (r₀ - s) (r₀ + s) ×ˢ Ioo (-s) s, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => q.1 • γ q.2) z ∧ Injective (fderiv ℝ (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => q.1 • γ q.2) z) ∧ fderiv ℝ (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => q.1 • γ q.2) z (1, 0) = γ z.2 ∧ fderiv ℝ (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => q.1 • γ q.2) z (0, 1) = z.1 • deriv γ z.2
